sentences.I dag snakker de om bolig med ei eldre,: Today they are talking about housing with an elderly Norwegian lady.
sentences.Jeg bodde i en stor enebolig før, men fo: I used to live in a big detached house, but two years ago I moved to a small apartment in the city centre. Do you live in a house or an apartment?
sentences.Jeg leier en leilighet i fjerde etasje i: I rent an apartment on the fourth floor of a block of flats, in a quiet area outside the centre. I have lived there for a year. The apartment is old and quite small. It is only 35 square metres, but it has a balcony.
sentences.På balkongen har jeg et lite, grønt bord: On the balcony I have a small green table and two chairs. I have a small living room with a really comfortable sofa. The kitchen is small and dark. I'm not very happy there, because a lot of small children live in the building, and they make a lot of noise.
sentences.Jeg drømmer om å bo sentralt, i en ny, m: I dream of living centrally, in a new, modern apartment.
sentences.Jeg er au pair og bor hos en norsk famil: I'm an au pair and live with a Norwegian family with two children. They own a nice detached house on Elgveien near the forest. The house is almost 300 square metres and has three floors. It is very modern, because they renovated last year.
sentences.Familien har bodd der i mange år, men je: The family has lived there for many years, but I have only lived there for five months. We have a cosy living room. In the living room we have a lovely soft sofa in front of a big TV. The kitchen is bright and nice, and there are five bedrooms in the house.
sentences.Soverommene er i andre etasje. Rommene t: The bedrooms are on the second floor. The children's rooms are small, but I have a big room. In my room I have a small desk, a TV and a blue sofa.
sentences.Viola og Biniam er på språkkafeen på bib: Viola and Biniam are at the language café at the library, speaking Norwegian.

sentences.Hun bodde i en enebolig før, men nå bor: She used to live in a detached house, but now she lives in a small apartment.
sentences.Biniam leier en gammel leilighet, men ha: Biniam rents an old apartment, but he wants to move, because he isn't happy there.
sentences.Viola bor i en stor enebolig sammen med: Viola lives in a big detached house with a Norwegian family.
sentences.Hun har et stort rom der og trives veldi: She has a big room there and is very happy.
It is common to own your own home in Norway.
sentences.Nordmenn tar ofte kontakt med banken for: Norwegians often contact the bank to get a loan to buy a home.
sentences.Noen kjøper leilighet, og noen kjøper en: Some buy an apartment, and some buy a detached house.
sentences.I byene bor mange i leiligheter, men på: In the cities many people live in apartments, but in small places it is common to live in a detached house.
sentences.Mange eneboliger har en leilighet i kjel: Many detached houses have an apartment in the basement, and the owner can rent it out to others.
